SmallCapDeleveragingReversalV1.mechanism: OI collapse + sharp drop + volume surge → forced liquidation bounce → long. V1.1: funding filter + systemic gate. V1.2: regime-gated trading rules with data-driven thresholds.

trend_down.rule: relaxed entry (0.50), full size — best regime

trend_up.rule: strict entry (0.75), half size — worst regime

v1.2_regime_gated.key_insight: BTC downtrend = real forced liquidations (86% hit). BTC uptrend drops = idiosyncratic weakness (17% hit).

gates: regime-based score thresholds: trend_down=0.50, range=0.60, trend_up=0.75
promotion_requirements: Expand data to 1000-bar for more regime samples
Validate regime rules hold with more trade samples

RelativeStrengthShockV1.mechanism: Small-cap coin shows significant outperformance vs BTC (RS > 5%) with volume + OI confirmation. Direction is REGIME-DEPENDENT: range → LONG (real accumulation), trend_down → SHORT (dead cat bounce fade), trend_up → SKIP (no edge). High frequency complement to Deleveraging Reversal.

latest_paper.key_insight: RS shocks in range are real accumulation (long wins). RS shocks in trend_down are dead cat bounces (short wins). Trend_up has no edge. This is the mirror image of Deleveraging Reversal's regime behavior.

promotion_requirements: Monitor correlation with Deleveraging Reversal (<0.3 target)
Test parameter stability across tighter RS thresholds

event_family_summary.complementarity: Deleveraging (low freq, high PF, OI-collapse events) + RS Shock (high freq, medium PF, RS events) — non-overlapping triggers, both profitable in trend_down via different mechanisms
